title: 2v2 No-Dribble Game
description: A half-court 2v2 game with no dribbling allowed, forcing constant movement, cutting and passing to create any kind of shot.

content.objective: Create good shots purely through cutting, passing and spacing with no dribble to rely on.
content.setup: Two offensive players face two defenders in a half-court game with the dribble removed.
instructions: Play live 2v2 to a target score, with no dribbling allowed at any point.
Players must move without the ball to create passing and cutting angles.
A travel or an attempted dribble results in a turnover.
Rotate in two new offensive players after every three possessions.
coachingPoints: Move constantly without the ball — standing still gets you denied easily.
Use pivots and fakes since the dribble isn't available to escape pressure.
Communicate cuts and screens out loud.
commonMistakes: Standing still after passing, expecting to get the ball right back.
Panicking and dribbling out of habit under pressure.
Reverting to one-on-one play instead of using the whole group.
content.safety: Keep contact minimal; call fouls to keep the pace controlled.
